description: Pi agent via its registry ACP adapter (package pi-acp). Subscription access stays in your Pi login; Garuda never reads it.
warnings: Vendor capability mediation is negotiated at handshake; strict garuda-only policies may be refused — review before mutating runs.
setup: 1. Install the Pi ACP adapter: npm install -g pi-acp. 2. Log in to Pi itself. 3. Verify: pi-acp --version. Garuda never reads your Pi credentials.

login.instructions: Log in to Pi, then select this runtime.
